result.finding: Container target OS is Linux (Debian/Ubuntu-based) via eclipse-temurin:8-jre base image. The project also includes Windows PowerShell scripts for Azure setup, indicating developer workstation support on Windows. Cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows) for local development via Docker.
evidence: Dockerfile final stage: FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre — based on Ubuntu/Debian Linux
Dockerfile build stage: FROM maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 — also Debian-based
azure-setup.ps1, azure-reset.ps1: PowerShell scripts (Windows developer tooling)
README.md: 'Docker Desktop installed and running' — cross-platform Docker Desktop supports Windows/macOS/Linux
values: Developer workstation: cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) via Docker Desktop
